scope: Bounded DE input, warrant, audit-status and bundle-consumer engineering profile. Passing mapped tests is not whole-BNS conformance, independent validation or certification.

requirement.text: - **BNS-II-001** For single-cell differential expression, an implementation MUST verify whether the matrix represents **raw counts** or **transformed expression** (log-normalized, scaled, z-scored) before model selection.

requirements.profile_scope_note: Numeric gate only; integer-likeness cannot authenticate biological raw-count provenance.

requirement.text: - **BNS-II-002** A negative-binomial count model (PyDESeq2 pseudobulk, scVI/totalVI generative likelihoods) MUST NOT be executed on log-normalized values without an explicit, recorded justification. In strict mode this is a deterministic refusal (`normalized_matrix_only` / `normalized_input`), with the remedy pointing at `adata.raw.X` or a `counts` layer.

requirements.profile_scope_note: Strict raw-count input gate; no model is executed by these tests, and no automatic raw/X substitution is allowed.

requirement.text: - **BNS-II-003** Integer-likeness checks MUST be performed on the actual matrix values (`audit_expression_matrix`), not inferred from file suffixes or user claims. A matrix of floats whose values are all integral MAY be accepted as counts; a matrix containing negative values MUST be refused as count input.

requirements.profile_scope_note: Dense and sparse actual values including invalid values at the final position; not filename or metadata inference.

requirement.text: - **BNS-II-010** Cell-level and sample-level experimental units MUST NOT be conflated. Condition inference on single cells without replicate aggregation is pseudoreplication and MUST be refused (BNS-005, `missing_replicates`).

requirements.profile_scope_note: Bounded warrant checks consume declared donor metadata; they do not independently authenticate donor identity.

requirement.text: - **BNS-EM-003** `UNTESTED` MUST NOT be conflated with `GRADE_C`: untested means the dimension was not evaluated; Grade C means it was evaluated and found weak.

requirements.profile_scope_note: EvidenceCard core: untested stays distinct from tested fragile or conflicted evidence.

requirement.text: - **BNS-EM-007** Reported maturity is a *prediction* of epistemic warrant. It MUST be evaluated against expected warrant on benchmark cases, not merely checked for internal consistency. The platform MUST report: exact accuracy, overconfidence rate (asserted rank > warranted rank), underconfidence rate, ordinal calibration error (OCE), Brier calibration score, and macro-F1 across maturity classes (`evals/metrics.compute_epistemic_calibration`).

evidence.note: Independent calibration of DE audit outcomes is not established by these synthetic/local tests.

requirements.acknowledged_limitation: Independent calibration of DE audit outcomes is not established by these synthetic/local tests.

requirement.text: - **BNS-PV-008** Consumers of an artifact MUST be able to verify the artifact against its recorded hash; mismatch MUST be surfaced as an integrity violation, not a warning.

requirements.profile_scope_note: Consumer hash consistency only; a rewritten manifest requires an external expected hash to detect, and no producer/scientific authority is granted.

requirement.text: - **BNS-PV-009** Provenance records MUST NOT be mutable after emission; corrections are new records superseding old ones (append-only audit semantics).

evidence.note: Readers detect byte mismatch and preserve prior bundles, but filesystem-enforced immutable storage and independently anchored append-only provenance are not established by this profile.

requirements.acknowledged_limitation: Readers detect byte mismatch and preserve prior bundles, but filesystem-enforced immutable storage and independently anchored append-only provenance are not established by this profile.

requirement.text: - **BNS-FW-008** Data-state checks that cannot be verified in the current environment MUST be rendered distinctly from checks that failed; an unverifiable state MUST NOT be displayed as a pass.

requirements.profile_scope_note: Passive DE audit status boundary only. The positive test uses synthetic self-declared execution metadata; ROBUST_PASS is the legacy audit status, not verified producer identity or independent scientific warrant.
